correctness.rationale: Specializing SQN to length five reduces the optimization, after symmetry, to two endpoint branches and explicit quadratics. The resulting universal bounds separate every non-Blackburn normalized pattern for q>=4, with q=7 checked in the sole threshold gap; q=2 and q=3 are solved directly. Equality conditions, Proposition 11 counting, symbolic algebra checks, exact finite enumeration, and a direct overlap test of the ternary construction agree.

originality.rationale: The 2024 exact-optimization paper states that no simple formula was available beyond length four and reports only finite length-five instances. Searches across non-overlapping, cross-bifix-free, mutually uncorrelated and strong comma-free terminology found no unrestricted all-q formula for S(q,5) or N(q,5). Potentially conflicting 2019 ternary wording resolves to maximality/non-expandability rather than maximum size beyond length three, and the checked 2026 generalized overlap-free paper addresses constructions and non-expandability rather than this maximum problem.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete all-alphabet exact formula at the first length beyond the published length-four theorem, classifies every maximum code for q>=4, isolates q=3 as the exceptional alphabet, gives an explicit residue-class maximizing split, and counts all maximum codes.
